record.rationale: Task1J8SQQ connects native JumpToTable/SID_CURRENTTAB26042 and one-based UInt16 Nr to actual Calc sheet view ownership. The asynchronous menu path uses the existing shared SfxDialogController,actual document sheet names and native selected-name result semantics. ScGoToTabDlg retains native ordered single selection,initial active sheet,case-sensitive untrimmed substring mask,selection clearing after filter rebuild,double-click acceptance,empty acceptance with no movement and cancellation. Shared Writer DialogHeader and office-dialog styles render the original entry/list/OK/Cancel/Help composition;Help stays disabled because its service is unported. Pending input must commit before opening;modal background is inert and file/page accelerators are suppressed;session closure cancels the request before destroying the model. This is not hidden-sheet/reference/VCL service parity or full Calc UI completion.
